messages:
alex_k: quick sync — onboarding gpt-small-v2 weights. HF repo is https://huggingface.co/redwood/gpt-small-v2 and we want a shadow mirror in s3 at s3://rw-artifacts/models/gpt-small-v2/. Can infra confirm mirroring policy + perms?

maria_s: I can check perms. Do we have a manifest.json in HF that lists checksum+shards? if not we need one for our artifact-registry validation.

alex_k: HF has model-index/sha256 in commits but no consolidated manifest. There are 4 shard files: weights-00001-of-00004.pt ..00004.pt. Expected sha256s listed in PR but not in root. PR: https://huggingface.co/redwood/gpt-small-v2/commit/aa12

samuel: artifact-bot can mirror but requires either public HF access or a presigned pull token. Which do you want? Public mirror or gated + presigned URL sync?

alex_k: gated — these are early weights. We prefer S3 only for now. Presigned pull token sounds right. TTL? we use 1h usually.

maria_s: ops: I created an IAM role and policy for mirror service; it can write to s3://rw-artifacts/models/gpt-small-v2/ and put-object. Will attach role to artifact-sync lambda. Also added kms:Encrypt for the key.

samuel: artifact-bot: starting dry-run sync. Will compare hf urls -> s3 keys and validate sha256. Will post results.

artifact-bot: dry-run report:
 - found 4 shards on HF
 - target keys: s3://rw-artifacts/models/gpt-small-v2/weights-00001-of-00004.pt ...
 - missing manifest.json in target
 - checksums: HF manifest (in PR) vs computed: two mismatch (00002, 00003) -> need reupload or retrigger upload on HF

alex_k: ugh, those two shards failed during the upstream push (prob transient). I'll ask the author to re-push with verified sha256. Thx for catching.

maria_s: small note on tokenizer: tokenizer.json in the HF repo is v1 but our tokenizer-loader expects 'vocab_size' as int in tokenizer_config.json. HF repo only has vocab.txt + merges. We need a tokenizer_config.json with {"vocab_size": 50256} or our validation will reject.

samuel: we have a config validation gate that rejects artifacts missing tokenizer_config.json or model_card. For now we can inject a minimal tokenizer_config during mirror, but better to get author to add it. Any objections?

alex_k: let's patch on mirror for staging only (artifact-v2-staging path) so loaders can run. For prod mirrors require author-provided tokenizer_config. Add a tag `mirror:staging-patched` to objects.

maria_s: done — staging prefix: s3://rw-artifacts/staging/gpt-small-v2/ with patched tokenizer_config.json. Wrote a small JSON: ```{
  "tokenizer_class": "GPT2Tokenizer",
  "vocab_size": 50256
}``` and set metadata x-amz-meta-source: hf://redwood/gpt-small-v2.

artifact-bot: checksum re-check after staging patch:
 - shards 00001..00004: now all match HF PR checksums except 00003 still mismatch -> HF shows sha256 a1b2.. but computed is a1b3..
 - suggestion: request author CI to run `sha256sum weights-00003-of-00004.pt` and reupload if necessary.

samuel: also note: our artifact-registry expects file names to include dtype suffix for quantized variants (e.g., weights-00001-of-00004.int8.pt). This is fine for main float32 but callout for future.

alex_k: noted. I'll ping model-owner. Maria, can you open a short runbook for onboarding that covers: HF manifest location, required tokenizer_config.json, naming conventions, and presign TTL policy? Put in docs/ or as a short markdown in the PR.

maria_s: will do. I'll create a small checklist and add it to the PR template. Also will add a CI check that verifies manifest+tokenizer_config presence.

alex_k: thanks. One last: when we flip mirror -> production, we want artifact-registry to run config validation (model.config dtype, hidden_size matches tokenizer vocab?). Can someone add that automated check?

samuel: adding a validator ticket. It will check: that model.config.hidden_size == computed embedding matrix width, tokenizer vocab size exists and > 1000, and shard checksums match manifest. Will also validate ACLs on S3 keys.

alex_k: perfect. wrapping up — I'll message the model author to re-upload 00003 and add tokenizer_config.json. Will follow up here when done. :thumbsup:

maria_s: noted. ping when author updates and we'll re-run artifact-bot.

samuel: I'll schedule automated recheck in 30m after author ping.

alex_k: thanks all.
